jobDescription:
About Us: Founded in 1972, Atari is one of the worlds most iconic consumer brands and a pioneer in the video game industry, known for creating classics like Pong, Asteroids, and Centipede. Today, Atari Inc. continues to build on its legacy by developing games, hardware, and experiences that honor the past while driving innovation for the future.

Whether youre helping launch a new game, keeping our infrastructure secure, or supporting day-to-day operations, your work here matters. Join us as we continue to grow Atari India and build the future of a legendary brand.
Position: Technical Program Coordinator
Experience: 5+ years
Location: Netaji Subhash Place, Pitampura, Delhi
Employment Type: Full-Time
About the Role
Ataris technology team spans infrastructure, DevOps, IT operations, and multiple engineering teams, with many initiatives running in parallel. A large part of this role is keeping that portfolio coordinated: holding the full picture of everything in motion, keeping parallel threads aligned and moving, and building the AI and automation that make this possible at scale. Technical leads own the delivery of their own teams work; this role complements them by holding the view across teams, connecting dependencies, and keeping shared goals aligned so the portfolio moves forward as a whole.
This is a hands-on, ownership-driven program management role with a strong emphasis on AI and automation. It suits someone who takes ownership of outcomes, brings order to complexity, and is energised by keeping many moving parts on track. Success comes through influence, credibility, and follow-through rather than formal authority.
Responsibilities
  • Take end-to-end ownership of assigned programs and be accountable for their delivery outcomes.
  • Maintain a single, accurate, and current view of all active projects across infrastructure, DevOps, and IT operations, covering owner, status, milestones, blockers, and risks, along with a cross-team dependency map that identifies conflicts before they affect delivery.
  • Track team goals and objectives, monitor progress against them, and keep each team aligned to the outcomes that matter most. Distinguish real progress from activity, and validate reported status through informed questioning.
  • Work with tech leadership to help resolve what is blocking progress and help resolve miscommunication and misalignment between teams.
  • Run the departments operating rhythm as a decision-making forum, ensuring each review concludes with clear owners, decisions, and deadlines that are followed through to closure.
  • Keep Technology and its business and executive stakeholders aligned on scope, priorities, and expectations, translating between technical and business audiences, surfacing concerns early, and communicating issues together with a recommended path forward.
  • Prepare executive updates and decision-ready briefs covering situation, options, recommendation, and the decision required, demonstrating the value Technology delivers in terms the business understands.
  • Design and build automation that reduces manual coordination and reporting work, treating the operating rhythm itself as a system to be engineered and continuously improved.
  • Apply AI tooling to convert meeting transcripts into action items, identify themes across ticket queues, summarise lengthy discussion threads, and draft updates and briefs.
  • Automate status reporting by integrating Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, and Slack or Teams, including early detection of schedule slippage, risk flagging, and proactive reminders to owners ahead of milestones.
  • Build and maintain KPI dashboards for each team covering delivery health, operational performance, and progress against goals, using metrics that reflect genuine improvement rather than volume of activity.
  • Identify recurring manual work across the operations organisation and progressively eliminate it through scripting, low-code tooling, and AI.
Requirements
  • 5+ years in engineering, infrastructure, IT operations, DevOps, technical delivery, or technical program management, with a track record of driving technical projects across multiple teams.
  • A strong aptitude for AI and automation, with hands-on experience using AI tools and a track record of automating manual and repetitive work. This is central to the role.
  • Strong program management fundamentals, and a clear ownership mindset with evidence of taking responsibility for outcomes rather than coordinating them. Comfort operating with ambiguity and structuring your own work independently.
  • High emotional intelligence, with the ability to read people and situations accurately, build trust quickly, and work effectively across teams. This is one of the most important qualities for the role.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to manage senior stakeholders, present credibly to a senior audience, and constructively challenge optimistic assessments while maintaining strong relationships.
  • Strong data literacy, with the ability to build KPI dashboards and reporting from delivery and operational data and define metrics that reflect genuine progress. Sufficient technical literacy to follow discussions on deployments, incidents, cloud infrastructure, and dependencies, and to assess reported progress with confidence. Working knowledge of Jira and Confluence.
Bonus Points
  • Python or an equivalent scripting language, applied to reporting, integration, or automation work.
  • Experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Zapier, or Power Automate, or with building against REST APIs.
  • SQL, and experience building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or Grafana.
  • Experience integrating LLMs or AI services into internal tools and workflows.
  • Examples of manual or repetitive processes you have identified and successfully automated.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with an ITSM platform such as ServiceNow, and exposure to audit or compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Exposure to SRE practices, incident management, or on-call operations.
  • Prior experience supporting a senior technology leader.
PMP, PRINCE2, and Scrum certifications are welcome but are not a requirement for this role.

We invite you to come grow with us.

Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, bringing together connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion and precision, we connect insight, strategy and execution to help clients make stronger decisions, accelerate performance and deliver lasting impact for patients. Data, technology and AI enhance this work, alongside the human expertise and judgement that define our advisory offer.

About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignites global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Design and redesign slides, proposal sections, RFP materials, credentials and case studies to improve clarity, visual hierarchy, structure and readability.
  • Apply Inizio Ignite brand standards, PowerPoint templates, visual systems and document standards consistently.
  • Translate clear briefs and developed content into polished visual outputs, escalating gaps or ambiguity early.
  • Adapt existing materials for different audiences, clients, geographies and pursuit contexts.

tagsAndSkills: adobe creative cloud,client delivery,ai,concurrent,craft,business development,case studies,iconography
jobDescription:
About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignites global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Own the design and delivery of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority client-facing materials.
  • Translate strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear visual narratives, page structures, diagrams and data stories.
  • Develop credible visual options based on the audience, content maturity, client context and available time.
  • Manage multiple assignments independently, clarify briefs with business stakeholders and flag scope, timing or quality risks early.
  • Apply and reinforce Inizio Ignite brand standards, templates, accessibility requirements and final-file standards.
  • Provide constructive craft feedback and practical support to Designer 1 colleagues, while escalating priority creative decisions to the Senior Designer.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through creative review or independent QA.
  • Create and refine reusable templates, slide components, visual systems, iconography and data-visualisation patterns.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, correctly named and version-controlled files that support reliable handover and future reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate understanding, exploration and production, while ensuring every output is accurate, appropriate and human-reviewed.
  • Contribute to studio standards, onboarding materials, knowledge capture and continuous improvement.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 4+ years of experience in presentation design, visual design, production design or a related creative role, ideally in healthcare, life sciences, consulting, professional services or an agency environment.
  • A strong portfolio showing polished client-facing presentation work, visual storytelling, slide redesign, data visualisation and alternative creative approaches.
  • Advanced PowerPoint skills and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or similar tools; charting experience would be advantageous.
  • Strong command of layout, typography, hierarchy, information design, brand application and final-file quality.
  • Ability to work directly with stakeholders, challenge unclear briefs constructively and manage expectations across several concurrent requests.
  • Experience giving useful craft feedback or supporting the development of less-experienced designers.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to evaluate AI-assisted outputs critically and responsibly.
  • High attention to detail, strong prioritisation and confidence working under time pressure without compromising core quality standards.
  • Ideal profile
  • You can move comfortably between fast-turn production work and more considered visual storytelling.
  • You take ownership, communicate clearly and know when to involve the Senior Designer or business stakeholder.
  • You enjoy helping others improve and contributing to shared standards, assets and ways of working.
  • You are motivated by the opportunity to shape a new Design Studio and strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

jobDescription:
Wolters Kluwer is a global leader in information, software solutions and services for professionals in healthcare; tax and accounting; financial and corporate compliance; legal and regulatory; corporate performance and ESG.

In this role as Principal DevOps Engineer, you will be working in Global Business Services, where we improve and transform our internal technology infrastructure, including IT operations, workplace technologies, cybersecurity, IT architecture, engineering services, and network and enterprise systems.

About the role

The Principal DevOps Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for designing, building, and optimizing enterprise-scale software systems and cloud platforms. This role combines deep technical expertise with leadership in DevSecOps, platform engineering, and cloud architecture. The Principal DevOps Engineer drives innovation, ensures engineering excellence, and leads cross-functional initiatives to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing solutions. This position also plays a key role in mentoring teams, influencing technical strategy, and integrating emerging technologies such as generative AI into engineering practices.

You will report to Manager of DevSecOps Engineering and work alongside a team of 6 dedicated colleagues.

As part of our dynamic DevOps community, you ll join a global network of passionate tech professionals who collaborate, support, and inspire each other across borders. You ll have the opportunity to:

  • Attend flagship events like Wolters Kluwer Technology Summit
  • Participate in industry-leading conferences such as Ignite
  • Compete in exciting challenges like the Code Games

We believe in continuous learning, innovation, and celebrating success together.

You will

  • Lead the design and engineering of scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise software and cloud platforms.
  • Define and implement best practices in software development, DevSecOps, and infrastructure automation.
  • Oversee the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of platforms using SRE principles.
  • Architect and manage cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), ensuring performance, cost-efficiency, and compliance.
  • Lead the development and optimization of CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
  • Guide the adoption of containerized and serverless architectures (e.g., Docker, AKS, Azure Functions).
  • Ensure adherence to security standards, conduct risk assessments, and lead compliance initiatives.
  • Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions and roadmaps.
  • Mentor and coach engineering teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Explore and integrate generative AI technologies to enhance software capabilities and automation.

You have

Education

  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

Experience

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in software engineering, DevSecOps, or platform engineering.
  • At least 3 years in a technical leadership role.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience with AI and generative AI technologies or equivalent exposure.
  • Proven experience in enterprise-scale application and infrastructure operations.

Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python) for automation and infrastructure tasks.
  • Deep expertise in programming frameworks (.NET, Java) and modern application development.
  • Extensive experience with Terraform and other IaC tools, including module development and maintenance.
  • Proficiency with CI/CD tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong architectural knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including service design and deployment.
  • Familiarity with SRE practices and tools for monitoring, incident management, and performance tuning.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills in complex technical environments.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and lead teams.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., PSD, Azure/AWS DevOps) are preferred.

Working together

  • Hybrid: This is a hybrid role, where you will spend at least eight days a month at our office, where youll enjoy the benefits of connecting and collaborating with your colleagues in person.

Join us, at Wolters Kluwer, and be part of a global technology company that makes a difference every day. Be the difference. If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we re getting to know you not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

title: Sr. Business Development Representative
jobDescription:
About the Role

As a Senior Business Development Representative, you will play a pivotal role at the front of the sales function by building a high-quality pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting. Working closely with UK-based Account Executives, you will identify, engage and qualify prospective customers, ensuring opportunities are effectively handed over for continued progression.

This is a high-activity role focused on personalised outreach, pipeline generation and maintaining excellent data quality. You will collaborate on account strategy and messaging, continuously refine outbound approaches, and contribute directly to the growth of the business through consistent execution and strong commercial awareness.

  • An experienced outbound prospector, ideally LinkedIn-led, within B2B technology or talent.

  • Self-starting, resilient and target-driven, with the ability to work UK hours alongside a UK-based team.

Benefits

  • Fully remote within India, working closely with a London-based team.
  • Generous holiday leave
  • The chance to build your sales career inside a scaling business with global ambition.

Senior AI & Data Engineer
This role has been designed as Onsite with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
Role Summary
The Senior AI & Data Engineer is an individual contributor role that acts as the technical subject matter expert at the intersection of AI engineering and data engineering. This is a uniquely dual-domain role: the successful candidate bridges the organization s data strategy with its AI agenda, ensuring that intelligent systems are built on a foundation of governed, high-quality, well-architected data.
On the AI side, this role designs and delivers end-to-end production-grade AI products architecting multi-agent frameworks, fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs, building robust ML pipelines, and ensuring AI solutions are scalable, explainable, and responsibly governed. On the data side, this role defines the data architecture, transformation standards, and quality frameworks that make those AI products possible owning the data platform across Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Collibra.
Beyond individual delivery, this role provides technical leadership across cross-functional initiatives, defines engineering standards for both AI and data engineering practice, and leads the Applied AI Engineer and AI Data Engineer. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise across the full stack: from classical machine learning and modern generative AI through to data architecture, governance, and pipeline engineering with the communication skills to translate that expertise into measurable business impact.

  • Agentic Workspace Solution Strategy: Collaborate with clients and Genpact sales teams to understand business goals, employee experience pain points, and the operating model the client wants to move toward.   • Sales Demos & Live Configuration: Act as the lead solution architect in the sales cycle for Agentic Workspace opportunities. Run high-impact, customer-facing demos and live configuration sessions. Showcase Agentic Experience suite, Spark Workspace and Spark Connect scenarios in front of client audiences. Drive discovery workshops, craft compelling proposals and RFP responses, scope effort, and coordinate with engineering to validate feasibility (scope, timeline, budget). Your goal is to increase win rate by delivering proposals that are both visionary and credible.

IP Ownership, Go-to-Market & Thought Leadership

  • Agentic Experience Suite IP Leader: Own the roadmap, productization, and evolution of Genpact's Agentic Experience suite. Define the offers, reference architectures, accelerators, and demo assets that make up the suite. Prioritize investment based on client demand and competitive differentiation; and ensure each component has clear value propositions, pricing, and delivery playbooks. Partner with Delivery and Engineering to harden field-built solutions into reusable IP and retire or refactor assets as the agentic landscape evolves.
  • Digital Workspace IP Leader (Spark Workspace & Spark Connect): Serve as the senior product owner for Rightpoint's Digital Workspace IP, including Spark Workspace and Spark Connect. Set the vision and feature roadmap, drive design and engineering priorities, oversee productization and packaging, and ensure tight alignment with the Microsoft platform stack and the broader Agentic Experience suite.
  • Thought Leadership: Be a recognized thought leader internally and externally for Agentic Workspace. Author whitepapers, blog posts, and whitepapers; speak at industry events, Microsoft partner forums, and client roundtables; and contribute to Genpact's brand as a leading agentic systems integrator.
  • Change Management for Agentic Adoption: Recognize that introducing agents into the workplace is a change management challenge as much as a technology one. Advise clients on agent governance, role design, training, and adoption and bake these into the solution so that Agentic Transformation is sustainable, responsible, and measurable.

Success Metrics / KPIs

  • Solution win rate in deals supported (e.g., percentage of proposals with this architect’s designs that convert to project wins), indicating ability to craft compelling, value-aligned architectures.
  • Quality of architecture in delivery: measured by post-implementation results such as performance benchmarks, scalability (can the platform handle expected load), and low incidence of architecture-related issues or rework during build.
  • Client satisfaction and business outcomes attributable to architecture: e.g., a client’s improved site performance or quicker content deployment times due to the designed solution (mapping back to KPIs the architect aimed to achieve).
  • Reusability of designs / accelerators: number of times architecture templates or components (developed under the architect’s guidance) are reused across projects, indicating creation of scalable best practices.
  • Continuous learning: staying certified/up-to-date – for example, maintaining relevant certs and attending partner training; success can be partially measured by completing new certifications or contributing to thought leadership (blogs, tech talks) on multi-platform solutions.

Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years in technical architecture roles for digital workspace and employee experience platforms, including substantial hands-on experience with Microsoft products (M365, Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint) in complex enterprise implementations.
  • Microsoft Agentic Platform Mastery: Deep expertise across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, and Azure AI Foundry, with working knowledge of Power Platform, SAM, Entra, and Purview as they relate to agent governance. Hands-on experience building and configuring agents is required.
  • Customer-Facing Sales & Solution Strength: 10+ years in solution consulting, pre-sales, or digital strategy, including a strong track record of leading executive sales demos and hands-on configuration sessions for enterprise audiences. title: Software Engineer (SRE)
jobDescription:
Role Summary

The SRE Engineer will play a key role in the Sophos development process by facilitating, managing, communicating, and automating tasks for the deployment and configuration of continuous feature builds for multiple development teams. By leveraging knowledge and expertise in the deployment of SaaS applications and microservices hosted in the cloud, the SRE engineer will streamline the process of quick and frequent automated builds and help elevate the Sophos development process to the next level of agility. As a member of the Sophos SRE team, you will work closely with software engineers, architects, product management and others to design and build the foundational toolset and capabilities that allow Sophos developers to quickly bring new features to market.

What You Will Do

  • Provide technical skillset to the SRE team by planning and designing SRE toolsets and automation.
  • Participate in architecture and security reviews for SRE Projects
  • Evangelize cloud technologies and CI/CD solutions for wider engineering teams
  • Focus on developing tools and processes for secure development practice.
  • Collaborate with multiple feature development teams to identify needs for building and deploying their applications.
  • Deploy and configure daily iterative builds of applications and containers into Tomcat server and Kubernetes clusters for multiple feature development teams. Deploy and configure MongoDB test databases with test data.
  • Design and implement automation for deployment and configuration tasks
  • Identify cloud infrastructure needs for deployment environments and manage costs.
  • Troubleshoot failed builds and deployments. Determine and fix environment and configuration issues. Analyze logs and communicate potential code issues to development teams.
  • Facilitate, manage and communicate information related to environments - their current state, deployed versions and availability to developers, QA engineers and team members.
  • Own and execute Github, Artifactory and Jenkins-based software configuration and release activities in central Git repositories and Jenkins builds, branching, tagging, building, releasing.
  • Support services and applications 24/7 by participating in an on-call rotation.

  • 2-4 years with some of the following technologies JAVA, Groovy, Python, Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong knowledge with scripting languages, preferably Python and Groovy
  • Experience with build tools like Gradle, Maven, NPM
  • Experience supporting production grade systems including Linux administration, deployment, high availability durability, practical logging monitoring, and cost optimization in a public cloud, preferably AWS
  • Hands on experience with Terraform
  • Knowledge of AWS services including EC2, ECS, EKS, Fargate, IAM, CloudWatch, SQS, SNS, S3 is preferrable.
  • Kubernetes and container orchestration experience a big plus
  • Experience with Blue/Green deployments is preferred
  • Experience with CI/CD tools and automation methodologies, specifically Jenkins
  • Strong working knowledge of Docker and the container ecosystem
  • Excellent operational knowledge of Linux operating systems
  • Administration and automation skills with developer tools like Bitbucket, Artifactory
  • Some experience with CI/CD automation for DevSecOps tools like Sonar, Blackduck

jobDescription:
DAU invites applications from outstanding candidates for faculty positions in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence at the Assistant Professor and Associate Professor levels.

While applications from all areas of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence are welcome, the University is particularly interested in candidates with expertise in the following domains:

  • Computer Systems and Networking: Operating Systems; Computer Networks; Distributed Systems; Cloud Computing; High-Performance Computing.
  • Software Engineering and Data Management: Databases; Data Mining; Data Warehousing; Software Design and Architecture; System Analysis and Design; Code Analysis and Software Quality Assurance; Software Testing and Verification.
  • Human Computer Interaction and Interactive Technologies: Human Computer Interaction (HCI); User Experience (UX) and User Interface (UI) Design; Cognitive Computing; Interaction Design; Intelligent and Adaptive Interfaces; Game Design and Development.
  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: Machine Learning; Deep Learning; Adversarial Machine Learning; Quantum Machine Learning; Multimodal Learning; Responsible and Trustworthy AI; Reinforcement Learning; Federated Learning; Artificial Intelligence and Ethics.
  • Natural Language Processing and Information Retrieval: Natural Language Processing (NLP); Large Language Models (LLMs); Knowledge Representation and Reasoning; Information Retrieval and Search Technologies.

Minimum Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must satisfy the following minimum requirements:

  • A Ph.D. degree in a relevant discipline, with a First Class or equivalent grade in the preceding degree(s), and an excellent academic record throughout; and
  • A strong and sustained research record, evidenced by publications in reputed peer-reviewed journals and leading international conferences.

Assistant Professor

Applicants should possess a Ph.D. degree, demonstrated research potential, and a strong commitment to excellence in teaching at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Candidates with postdoctoral research experience and evidence of independent research capability will be given preference.

Associate Professor

Applicants should have a minimum of six years of post-Ph.D. experience in teaching, research, or relevant professional practice, of which at least three years should be at the level of Assistant Professor (or an equivalent position) at a higher educational institution or research organization.

Candidates are expected to have an established record of scholarly achievement, demonstrated through:

  • High-quality publications in reputed journals and conferences;
  • Success in securing externally funded research grants and projects;
  • Experience in supervising doctoral students and mentoring research scholars; and
  • Evidence of academic leadership and professional contributions to the discipline.

Industry Professionals

The University also welcomes applications from candidates with significant industry experience and a strong research and innovation profile. Professionals who have made substantial contributions to research, product development, technology innovation, or industrial RD and are passionate about teaching and mentoring students are encouraged to apply.

The University particularly values candidates who can bridge academia and industry through collaborative research, technology transfer, entrepreneurship, and experiential learning initiatives.

Salary per year in Cost to the Institute (CTI) format

Assistant Professor: Minimum starting salary is 20 Lakh per annum.
(Exceptionally qualified and experienced candidates may be considered for higher compensation and additional incentives commensurate with their credentials, achievements, and potential contributions.)

Perquisites Benefits

Research Support and Professional Development

  • Seed Research Grant: Up to 10 Lakh to support the establishment of research activities and laboratory infrastructure.
  • Professional Development Allowance: A cumulative allowance of 3 Lakh every three years (on a reimbursable basis) to support participation in national and international conferences, workshops, and other professional development activities.
  • Research Excellence Incentive: Financial reward of 1 Lakh for each publication in top-tier A/A-ranked conferences and Q1 journals.

Health, Insurance and Other Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical Insurance: Health insurance coverage of up to 10 Lakh per annum for the faculty member and eligible family members under a floater policy. The entire premium is borne by the Institute.
  • OPD medical reimbursement: 5000 per month for OPD medical expenses.
  • Children Education Allowances: 50000 per year ( 25000 per child, and coverage up to two children.)
  • Leave Travel Concession: 1.5 Lakh for a 4-year block.
  • Interest free loan up to 5 Lakh.

Leave and Work-Life Balance

  • Casual Leave: 8 days per year.
  • Special Casual Leave: 15 days per year.
  • Vacation: Up to 60 days of vacation annually. Unavailed vacation is converted to earned leave (up to 30 days per year).
  • Earned Leave Encashment: Accumulated earned leave is encashable upon separation from the University, as per applicable policies.

Career Growth

  • Career Progression (Policy): A transparent and well-defined faculty career advancement framework that recognizes excellence in teaching, research, and institutional service.
  • Teaching Load: Faculty members typically teach three courses per academic year. To facilitate a smooth transition, newly appointed faculty members are assigned a reduced teaching load of two courses during their first year (one course per semester).

Research Collaboration and Industry Engagement

DAU actively encourages faculty members to pursue collaborative research and innovation initiatives with leading academic institutions, research laboratories, government agencies, and industry partners in India and abroad. The University provides a supportive environment for securing external research funding, undertaking interdisciplinary projects, and translating research outcomes into societal and industrial impact.

title: Lead Generation : Definition & Meaning
tagsAndSkills: conversion optimization,brand building,cold calling,back office,ai,business development,advertising,brand strategy
jobDescription:
Lead generation is the systematic process of identifying and attracting potential customers who demonstrate interest in a company's products or services.

What Is Lead Generation

Marketing teams, sales professionals, and business development specialists use lead generation to build sustainable revenue pipelines, reduce customer acquisition costs, and achieve predictable growth targets through systematic prospect identification and engagement processes.

What Are The Primary Lead Generation Methods Used By Marketing Teams

Marketing teams implement 8 primary lead generation methods to attract and capture qualified prospects. These lead generation approaches are listed below:

  • Content marketing: Organizations create valuable blog posts, whitepapers, ebooks, and educational resources to attract prospects searching for industry solutions and expertise
  • Search engine optimization: Marketing teams optimize website content and landing pages to rank higher in search results for keywords that potential customers use during research phases
  • Pay-per-click advertising: Companies run targeted ads on Google, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other platforms to capture leads actively searching for specific products or services
  • Email marketing campaigns: Organizations send targeted email sequences to newsletter subscribers, webinar attendees, and content downloaders to nurture relationships and generate sales opportunities
  • Webinars and events: Companies host virtual and in-person events, trade shows, conferences, and educational sessions to demonstrate expertise and collect contact information from attendees
  • Referral programs: Businesses incentivize existing customers, partners, and industry contacts to recommend qualified prospects through structured referral systems and reward programs
  • Cold outreach: Sales development representatives contact potential customers through phone calls, LinkedIn messages, and personalized emails based on targeted prospect lists and research

What Are the Types of Lead Generation

Lead generation encompasses 6 primary types that businesses use to attract and capture potential customers. These lead generation approaches are listed below based on their channel characteristics and targeting methods.

  • Content marketing, SEO, social media Attracting prospects through valuable content
  • Cold calling, email campaigns, direct mail Proactively reaching out to potential customers
  • PPC advertising, social ads, display campaigns Capturing leads through online advertising
  • Event-Based Lead Generation Trade shows, webinars, conferences Generating leads through direct engagement
  • Customer referrals, partner networks Leveraging existing relationships for new leads
  • Account-Based Lead Generation Targeted campaigns, personalized outreach Focusing on specific high-value accounts

What Are the Key Components of Lead Generation Systems

Effective lead generation systems contain 5 essential components that work together to identify, capture, and nurture potential customers throughout the sales funnel.

  • Lead Magnets Valuable content offers like whitepapers, ebooks, webinars, or free trials that attract prospects and encourage contact information sharing.
  • Landing Pages Dedicated web pages designed to convert visitors into leads through compelling copy, clear value propositions, and optimized conversion forms.
  • Lead Capture Forms Data collection mechanisms that gather prospect information including name, email, company, and qualifying questions to assess lead quality.
  • Lead Scoring Systems Automated frameworks that assign point values to leads based on demographics, behavior, and engagement level to prioritize sales follow-up.
  • Lead Nurturing Workflows Automated email sequences and content delivery systems that educate prospects and maintain engagement until they reach sales-ready status.

What Is Lead Generation Formula

Lead Conversion Rate Formula

Lead Conversion Rate = (Number of Converted Leads Total Number of Leads) 100

This formula measures how effectively leads progress through the sales funnel, with each variable representing critical performance indicators:

  • Number of Converted Leads represents prospects who completed the desired action, such as making a purchase, signing a contract, or scheduling a consultation within the measurement period.
  • Total Number of Leads includes all qualified prospects who entered the sales funnel during the same timeframe, regardless of their final conversion status.
  • Conversion Rate Percentage indicates the efficiency of the lead nurturing process, with industry benchmarks ranging from 2-5% for most B2B sectors and 1-3% for B2C markets.

Sample Lead Generation Calculation

A software company generates 500 leads through digital marketing campaigns and converts 25 leads into paying customers during Q1.

Step 1: Identify converted leads = 25 customers

Step 2: Identify total leads = 500 prospects

Step 3: Apply formula = (25 500) 100

Step 4: Calculate result = 0.05 100 = 5%

The 5% conversion rate indicates above-average performance for B2B software sales, suggesting effective lead qualification and nurturing processes that convert 1 in every 20 prospects.

Important Considerations

Lead quality varies significantly across acquisition channels, making total volume metrics misleading without segmentation by source, qualification criteria, and conversion timeframes. Track conversion rates separately for each marketing channel to identify the most cost-effective lead generation strategies.

What Are Lead Generation Related Terms

Lead generation intersects with 7 distinct business development concepts that professionals often confuse or misapply. These related terms represent different stages, approaches, and outcomes within customer acquisition strategies.

Key Distinction from Lead Generation Creates market awareness and interest before capturing leads Brand building and market education campaigns Evaluates and scores existing leads for sales readiness Sales process optimization and resource allocation Develops relationships with existing leads over time Marketing automation and customer journey management Complete process from initial contact to paying customer Strategic planning and performance measurement Researches and identifies potential customers before contact Outbound sales strategy and target market analysis Improves rates at which visitors become leads or customers Digital marketing and website performance improvement Tracks and manages entire customer journey from awareness to purchase Sales operations and revenue forecasting

Lead Generation vs. Demand Generation

Lead generation captures contact information from prospects who already show interest, while demand generation creates that initial interest through market education and brand awareness campaigns. Demand generation precedes lead generation in the customer acquisition timeline.

Lead Generation vs. Lead Qualification

Lead generation focuses on quantity by attracting and capturing prospect information, while lead qualification emphasizes quality by evaluating which leads possess genuine purchase intent and budget authority. Qualification follows generation in sales processes.

Lead Generation vs. Lead Nurturing

Lead generation obtains initial prospect contact information through single interactions, while lead nurturing develops ongoing relationships with those prospects through sequential communications over weeks or months until they reach purchase readiness.

Lead Generation vs. Customer Acquisition

Lead generation represents one component within customer acquisition by providing potential buyer contact information, while customer acquisition encompasses the complete journey from initial awareness through final purchase and onboarding activities.

Lead Generation vs. Prospect Development

Lead generation uses inbound methods to attract prospects who voluntarily provide contact information, while prospect development employs outbound research to identify and contact potential customers who have not yet expressed direct interest.

Lead Generation vs. Conversion Optimization

Lead generation creates systems and campaigns to attract potential customers, while conversion optimization analyzes and improves the performance of existing lead generation assets to increase response rates and contact capture efficiency.

Lead Generation vs. Sales Funnel Management

Lead generation feeds prospects into the top of sales funnels through specific acquisition activities, while sales funnel management oversees the entire pipeline from initial contact through closed deals, including lead generation as one input component.

What Are the Core Distinctions Between These Terms

5 fundamental differences separate lead generation from related customer acquisition concepts across timing, scope, and measurement criteria.

  • Timeline Position: Lead generation occurs at specific points in customer journeys, while demand generation happens earlier and customer acquisition spans the entire process from awareness to purchase.
  • Success Metrics: Lead generation measures contact capture.

title: Security Engineer II (AI)
jobDescription:
Job Description

At SIXT, AI is changing how work gets done and we are looking for the person who will help us do it safely. As an AI Security Engineer, you will shape how SIXT understands, assesses, and secures AI usage across the organisation, exploring where AI touches our data and systems, defining what safe usage looks like, and building the detections and controls that keep AI behaviour secure. This is a builders role at the frontier of a fast-moving field handson, high-ownership, and directly influential in making responsible AI adoption real at a global scale. If you are excited about defining what secure AI looks like inside a world-class organisation, apply now and become part of Team Orange.

YOUR ROLE AT SIXT

  • You assess AI tooling and AI-built applications across SIXT, identify and derive associated security risks, and present clear, actionable findings to relevant stakeholders for informed decision-making
  • You author remediation policies that keep AI usage inside agreed boundaries, automating enforcement so it does not depend on manual review
  • You partner with teams and business units building their own AI-powered tools, steering them toward more secure approaches and making risk-based decisions on what AI usage is acceptable
  • You define the baseline of healthy, productive AI usage that SIXT should actively encourage, and track progress through clear KPIs that show how risk is being reduced over time
  • You respond to AI-related security incidents, containing issues quickly and decisively, and work continuously with security and engineering teams to improve and automate AI governance controls
  • You partner with Security, Legal, and Data Protection colleagues to keep AI usage aligned with the EU AI Act, GDPR, and other evolving regulatory obligations

YOUR SKILLS MATTER

  • Education Experience You have Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, with 3 5 years of experience in security engineering
  • Security Assessment You run pragmatic security assessments, translate risk patterns into reliable rules including deterministic detections, remediation policies, regular expressions and propose safer alternatives constructively without becoming a blocker
  • AI Security Knowledge You bring real knowledge of AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, and agentic and tool-use risks, alongside a solid understanding of modern AI architectures including LLMs, RAG systems, and tool-use workflows
  • Risk Methodology You have practical experience applying a structured security risk-assessment methodology such as CVSS or equivalent to score, document, and communicate risk consistently
  • Communication You possess strong written communication skills and can make findings and decisions clear enough that colleagues can act on them with confidence, including comfort with making decisions under ambiguity and knowing when to escalate
  • Collaboration: You enjoy working across time zones with global teams, and bring familiarity with observability platforms to gain visibility into system and AI behaviour

Role: Data Scientist Rider Growth

Location: Bangalore

About LoadShare

LoadShare is one of India’s most innovative and resilient logistics platforms, transforming how goods move across the country. Founded in 2017, we’ve grown to become a pan-India, multi-category last-mile network with a unique presence in both Tier 1 metros and deep Tier 2/3 towns.

What sets us apart:

  • Scale with depth: We handle ~550K deliveries/day across food, e-commerce (B2C), B2B retail, and digital commerce, powered by a 30,000+ rider network.
  • Strong financials, stronger ambition: With 800+ Cr in FY26 revenue and support from global investors (Tiger Global, Matrix, BII, Stellaris, BeeNext), we have a long runway and a path to profitability.
  • Dual-engine model: We not only operate India’s most flexible last-mile delivery network, but also license our in-house logistics tech platform that processes an additional 20 lakh orders/day — one of the few in India to enable asset cross-utilization across verticals.
  • Strong Tech: We are in a unique position to cross-utilize the delivery boys across different earning opportunities matching the peaks of various use-cases throughout the day. (ex: grocery peaks at 6-8 am, while bike taxi peaks from 8 to 10 am, etc). In addition to this, our supply chain SaaS platforms power over 1M+ shipments per day.
  • Strategic partner to India’s digital economy: We work with every major digital commerce player (ecomm, quick commerce, food, mobility) , and are expanding wallet share and capabilities within existing giants while co-creating new models with emerging platforms and brands.
  • Built to scale profitably: We’re not chasing GMV at all costs. We’re building the most capital-efficient, tech-enabled logistics engine in the country. We’re now building for our next phase: a 5X scale-up over the next 5 years, anchored in sharper client focus, deeper solutions, and new growth engines.

Founders/ Founding team:

  • Raghu Talluri (CEO) - Formerly at Myntra, McKinsey
  • Pramod Nair (CTO) - Formerly at Freecharge, Snapdeal, MartMobi
  • Rakib Ahmed (Co Founder, Head EComm/ Trucking/Warehousing)- Formerly at ICICI Prudential, Co founder Lunate Eco

The Role: Where Growth Meets Data Science

We're hiring a Data Scientist for the Rider Growth charter of LoadShare Product Org. This role goes beyond preparing data, conducting analysis and building dashboards. Your job starts where that ends: figuring out why a metric moved, and turning that into experiments and models that move it.

Your will look at the entire lifecycle of riders - acquisition, activation, retention, revenue and referral. You will own the why behind every growth metric and convert it into experiments and models that move the needle.

What You'll Work On

  • Causal analysis & RCA: Establish causation, not correlation, for why acquisition/activation/retention metrics move. Use controlled experiments, diff-in-diff, and quasi-experimental methods to move the team from "what happened" to "why, and what to do next."
  • Dynamic offers & incentives (ML): Build models for personalized/dynamic offers to address new rider hiring, engagement and reactivation at the right place and right time, balancing uplift in DAU and CAC.
  • Experimentation muscle: Design, run, and read rigorous A/B tests; own lift measurement; build the experimentation discipline so launches stop being "assume and ship."
  • Segmentation & cohorting: Rider and funnel segmentation, retention/cohort curves, and driver/decision-tree analysis to find the patterns that explain behaviour.
  • Forecasting & churn (retention side): Predict supply needs, churn risk, and recovery to inform retention and re-engagement strategy.

What We're Looking For

  • 3-5 years in Data Science/ML
  • Strong first principles — the core bar.
  • Python and practical ML: segmentation, decision trees, regression, and basic causal-inference methods.
  • Real grounding in experimentation and statistics — A/B testing, controlled experiments, reading lift honestly.
  • AI-native: uses Claude/LLM tooling to accelerate analysis
  • Strong communication, comfort being embedded with a PM and business teams, and a bias for action.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Growth, activation, or retention analytics or ML modelling experience.
  • Experience with dynamic pricing/incentives, geospatial data, or experimentation platforms.
